name: vscode-window-labeler
summary: Give every VS Code window a visible name and a distinct title-bar color so you can tell your projects apart at a glance.
install: curl -fsSL -o vscode-window-labeler.tar.gz https://github.com/primovera12/gnesis-vault/releases/latest/download/vscode-window-labeler.tar.gz && tar xzf vscode-window-labeler.tar.gz && cd vscode-window-labeler && bash install.sh
